segments.text: Gemma translator is a two-way voice translator that runs entirely on a Raspberry Pi 5 with no internet after setup. Two lanes face each other on a
small kiosk screen, each with a rotating language selector. Hold a key, speak, and the other side hears it back in their language. Moonshine handles the
speech in and out. Gemma does the translation and the repo ships STL files for the
